voice.summary: Sounds like a friendly shopkeeper who weighs everything before recommending it. Savings are stated plainly as pounds off, not hype.
dos: State the saving as a number
Name each product by what it does
Keep calls to action to three words

taglines: Pick any three, save a fifth
Fill the box, see the saving
